note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is thin on the four earliest `dmr-*` records (`factory`, `generator`, `round` only) in `batch-r01.jsonl` and `batch-r02.jsonl`, while every record from `batch-r03.jsonl` onward adds `kind` / `plant` / `sim_or_real` and, from round 818 on, `surface`: the datasets-server infers `meta` from `batch-r01.jsonl`, can read the equally thin `batch-r02.jsonl`, then cannot cast the richer rows beginning in `batch-r03.jsonl`, so declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

disclosures.summary: Four records carry a thin `meta` of `{factory, generator, round}` with no `kind` / `plant` / `sim_or_real`. They are the earliest `dmr-*` episodes, in `batch-r01.jsonl` and `batch-r02.jsonl`, and seed the datasets-server's inferred schema. The 2722 later records add `kind` / `plant` / `sim_or_real` (and 1092 also add `surface`), so those richer later rows are the cast failures. The four source records are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: 172 of 2726 record ids contain `leftover`. That is this factory's own advertised leftover-object mechanic (leftover extensions, sequences, constraints, publications and migration-tool bookkeeping rows left behind by a half-applied migration), not a foreign dump: every one is stamped `db-migration-repair-factory` and generated by `grok-4.6`.

disclosures.summary: There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset. All 2726 records carry `meta.factory` `db-migration-repair-factory` and `meta.generator` `grok-4.6`, and every id is `dbm-*` (2722) or `dmr-*` (4); no `factory_mix` key and no foreign-prefixed id occurs in any shard. This dataset therefore opens no leftover census of its own; the definition of that class lives in the frozen sibling censuses, which cover other destinations only and own no record here.

disclosures: Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (43630 of 43630). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
